messages:
alex: Hey team — customer hitting 401 invalid_api_key after we rolled nginx ingress change. Repro with curl:

alex: ```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_REDACTED ' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
* Server certificate: OK
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
< Content-Type: application/json
< x-request-id: rq_6a1b2c3d
{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"key rejected"}
```

maria: Can you paste the x-request-id and the customer app logs? Also which region?

alex: x-request-id rq_6a1b2c3d, region eu-west-1. App log shows Authorization header appended by client lib:

alex: ```
INFO 2026-03-16T12:01:23Z Sending headers: Authorization: Bearer sk_live_... 
```

jess: That trailing char looks suspicious. Could be a non-breaking space (U+00A0) from copy/paste or from some i18n layer. Our header parser treats tokens strictly so extra byte makes it not match.

sam: Can you confirm raw bytes on the TCP stream? Use `curl --trace-ascii -` or tcpdump to see hex.

alex: Ran `curl --trace-ascii -` and saw this around the header:

alex: ```
=> Send header: Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx\xc2\xa0\r\n
```

jess: Yep that's UTF-8 NBSP (0xC2 0xA0). Nginx may pass it through and our auth code is doing exact prefix match `Authorization: Bearer ` so it fails.

infra-bot: FYI this pattern also showed up in a previous incident where some mobile SDKs appended NBSP when concatenating strings from templates.

maria: Short-term: we can normalize header before validation to strip Unicode whitespace. Sam, can you push a small router patch to trim header bytes? Also let's add a decoding step that rejects suspicious control chars.

sam: I'll push a canary to us-east-1 with normalization + logging. Will also add a metric for `auth.header.normalized`.

support-bot: Ticket #INC-5472 created; assigned to sam. Notifying customer with repro and ETA.

alex: Customer confirmed they copied key from a PDF and likely introduced a NBSP. They cleaned up and now get 200. Thanks team.

jess: We'll keep the normalization patch for 48h and roll to prod if no regressions. Also add a note in troubleshooting docs: "Trim non-breaking space and invisible Unicode when pasting keys".

maria: Closing thread once patch is in prod and customer notified.
